title: Digital Safety and Online Communities
description: This module supports communities to understand digital safety risks related to DFV, including online abuse, tech-facilitated coercion, and unsafe digital behaviours. It focuses on building safer online communities, recognising digital red flags, and supporting people experiencing digital forms of abuse.
outcomes: Recognise digital risks and online behaviours associated with DFV
Support safer online practices within communities
Identify and respond to tech-facilitated abuse in safe and appropriate ways
